attchmntText: KCP Sugar and Industries Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Board Comments on fine levied by the Exchange.'.
sm_name: KCP Sugar and Industries Corporation Limited
voiceSummary: K.C.P. Sugar and Industries Corporation Limited informed the National Stock Exchange that the Board noted a fine of Rs. 8,000 levied for the delayed submission of the Annual Report for the year ended March 31, 2026. The delay was attributed to an inadvertent oversight. The Company has paid the fine. The Board expressed concern over the lapse and advised management to strengthen internal compliance monitoring to prevent recurrence. The NSE had issued a notice on October 30, 2026, regarding non-compliance with Regulation 34 of the SEBI LODR Regulations. The total fine including GST was Rs. 9,440. The Board comments were placed before the directors at their meeting.

attchmntText: KCP Sugar and Industries Corporation Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
sm_name: KCP Sugar and Industries Corporation Limited
voiceSummary: K.C.P. Sugar and Industries Corporation Limited approved its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the Second Quarter and Half Year ended 30th September 2026. The Board met on 12th November 2026 via Video Conferencing. Statutory Auditors M/s. B.Purushottam & Co issued an Unmodified Audit Report. Standalone revenue from operations was Rs. 6582.96 Lakhs for the quarter and Rs. 13396.84 Lakhs for the half year. Standalone profit after tax was Rs. 3670.62 Lakhs for the quarter and Rs. 8227.09 Lakhs for the half year. Consolidated revenue from operations was Rs. 7835.39 Lakhs for the quarter and Rs. 15638.05 Lakhs for the half year. Consolidated profit after tax was Rs. 3932.24 Lakhs for the quarter and Rs. 8557.01 Lakhs for the half year. The company also announced a reduction in order value with The EIMCO-KCP Limited. The initial purchase order of Rs. 130 Crores was reduced to Rs. 102 Crores due to unavailability of specific SS 2507 plates in India.

attchmntText: KCP Sugar and Industries Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Disclosure of delayed submission of report to Stock Exchange'.
